generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The agency should have experience in similar nature of work like Refurbishment/strengthening of IDCT by application of Glass flake coating/Polyceramic coating in coal-fired thermal plants of capacity 500MW and above as a prime agency and should have executed a single work order with a value not less than Rs 20.94 Lakhs, for which the agency should submit the relevant work done certificate along with the work order copy issued by competent authority during the last preceding 5 years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26).

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Bidder shall have annual average turnover of Rs. 41.88 lakhs in any two of the preceding five financial years 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26. As a proof, the bidder shall furnish a copy of Profit & Loss account statement or turnover certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant.
